evidence_used: visual estimate of avocado scale and mass (approximately 150 to 200 grams)
pebbled, rough texture of the avocado skin providing good friction properties for the silicone pad
ellipsoidal geometry allowing a stable parallel-jaw grasp
calculation_summary: Estimated object weight W ~ 1.8 N based on visual scale. Assuming a conservative coefficient of friction mu ~ 0.5 for silicone on pebbled organic skin, minimum normal force for vertical lift with a two-finger parallel jaw gripper is F_n = W / (2 * mu) = 1.8 / (2 * 0.5) = 1.8 N, adjusted up to 3.5 N to account for gravitational safety factor, slight curvature, and slip prevention.
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Exact object mass is unmeasured and estimated purely from visual appearance.
Friction coefficient between high-friction silicone and avocado skin is assumed based on qualitative surface condition.
Uncertainty exists regarding the exact firmness and surface compliance of the specific avocado.
reasoning_trace: The visual input shows a standard-sized avocado resting on a surface. The silicone gripper embodiment description specifies high-friction silicone pads effective on rough or irregular surfaces. The pebbled texture of the avocado skin offers a favorable tactile profile for the high-friction silicone pads, supporting high compatibility. Given an estimated mass of roughly 150-200g, a normal force of 3.5 N provides a secure, non-slip grasp under standard parallel-jaw lifting conditions without crushing the produce.
